# Veritya Daily

> Independent technology, cryptocurrency, finance, and artificial intelligence news publication. We publish original analysis — not aggregated or scraped content — covering AI tools, crypto markets, finance, and cybersecurity. Our content is for information and education only and is not financial advice.
